description: Full company profile by the id returned from search_companies. 1 credit. Includes revenue_type, revenue_confidence and source where financials are available. Financial fields (revenue, employees, net income) are returned only for FR, NO, LT, EE, LV, CO, where the data licence is confirmed; for all other countries the record carries financials_withheld='licence_not_confirmed'. Where present, revenue_type is 'reported' (filed accounts) or 'estimated' (model estimate). Keep the data_licences field of the output when displaying or redistributing data (attribution required).
name: lookup_company
